question: Which exact meanings are title-proved for the six resource-header dwords consumed by Resolve 0x8269E520?

scope.boundary: This packet joins the exact 0x34-byte resource-header builder and base patcher to the six-dword descriptor interface decoded by Resolve. It assigns only roles proved by matching writes and reads. It does not prove the exact runtime creator arguments for the destination at 0x8250AFEC, a public API resource type, host layout, allocation generation, lifetime, or completion.

dependencies.use: Provides the accepted exact Resolve callsite, creator path, six-dword VdSwap ABI, and operation-provenance boundary.

creationPath.creator: 0x82533DB8
creationPath.result: The creator allocates the 0x34-byte header, obtains primary and optional secondary backing sizes from the builder chain, allocates the backing regions through 0x82E29168, and patches their page bases into descriptor words 1 and 5 while preserving each word's low 12 bits. The caller values that select the exact runtime destination at 0x8250AFEC remain unresolved.

resolveConsumer.unusedWord: +0x2C has no direct read in the exact Resolve body
resolveConsumer.result: Resolve directly decodes five of the six descriptor dwords. It extracts the numeric format from word 1 low six bits, the page base from word 1 high bits, two encoded extents from word 2, and layout or control fields from words 0, 3, and 5.

descriptorWords.producer: 0x8269A378 packs control fields; 0x82533DB8 separately sets bit 0x00200000 when optional secondary backing is present.
descriptorWords.consumer: Resolve extracts a different packed bit range that affects its layout calculation; it does not consume producer bit 0x00200000.
descriptorWords.unresolved: The optional-secondary producer flag is not joined to a Resolve consumer, and no complete public field naming is proved.

descriptorWords.producer: 0x8269A378 places the input's low-six-bit format selector in bits 0..5; 0x826B7140 adds the primary allocation page base while preserving bits 0..11.
descriptorWords.consumer: Resolve reads bits 0..5 as the numeric format and bits 12..31 as the primary address base; the accepted VdSwap ABI independently consumes the same roles.
descriptorWords.provedRole: primary page base plus numeric format and low control bits
descriptorWords.unresolved: The exact runtime numeric format at 0x8250AFEC is not statically selected.

descriptorWords.producer: 0x8269A378 initializes the word before direct helper 0x82699208 participates in its construction.
descriptorWords.consumer: Resolve decodes two packed extent-minus-one fields and adds a sample-dependent increment; the accepted VdSwap ABI derives width and height from this word.
descriptorWords.unresolved: The helper body was outside the exhausted eight-body cap, so the complete producer formula and exact runtime dimensions remain unresolved.

descriptorWords.producer: 0x8269A378 packs multiple input and derived control fields.
descriptorWords.consumer: Resolve extracts addressing, sample, and layout-control bits used in destination offset and copy-state calculation.
descriptorWords.unresolved: Pitch, slice, level, region, tiling, and sample-count subfields are not individually named by the bounded title evidence.

descriptorWords.consumer: The exact Resolve body contains no direct read from this word.
descriptorWords.unresolved: No Resolve-side semantic field is proved.

descriptorWords.producer: 0x8269A378 packs low control bits; when secondary backing exists, 0x826B7140 adds its page base while preserving bits 0..11.
descriptorWords.consumer: Resolve tests only control bits 9..10 while deriving layout behavior; it does not consume the page-base bits.
descriptorWords.provedRole: producer-side optional secondary page base and Resolve-consumed low control bits
descriptorWords.unresolved: The secondary page base has no matching Resolve consumer. Its payload role and any slice, level, or region meaning are not proved.

boundedNegatives: The bounded producer and Resolve consumer do not prove a public resource class or exact runtime width, height, pitch, sample count, slice, level, or region for callsite 0x8250AFEC.
Descriptor word 4 has no direct Resolve read, and its producer packing alone does not authorize a semantic name.
The descriptor snapshot remains operation provenance, not an allocation-generation or lifetime key.

currentEvidence.method: One foreground read-only FindFieldRefs.java query over the six descriptor offsets and six accepted functions, followed by narrow generated-code corroboration for the eight exact bodies allowed by the packet.
currentEvidence.ghidraResult: The configured bodies exposed no field-reference rows because the functions truncate at their save thunks; that zero is not treated as semantic closure.
currentEvidence.qualification: Generated code corroborates exact functions selected from accepted anchors and the foreground query; it is not used as executable-wide discovery authority.

catalogPromotion.result: The proved roles qualify the existing Resolve/resource frontier without creating a new reusable identity.

missingContracts.reason: Primary address, numeric format, packed extents, and coarse control roles are proved, but the exact runtime resource type, remaining field-level contract, generation, lifetime, completion, and native submission contract are not.

guards: Do not name packed subfields from Xenos format familiarity without matching title producer and consumer dataflow.
Do not use the six dwords or a guest pointer as a persistent host-resource identity.
Do not treat readable backing memory or descriptor equality as GPU completion.
conclusion: The exact title path proves a 0x34-byte resource header whose descriptor word 1 carries the primary page base and numeric format, word 2 carries packed width and height extents, and word 5 can receive an optional secondary page base on the producer side. Resolve consumes separate control bits from words 0, 3, and 5 but does not consume the optional-secondary flag in word 0 or the secondary page base in word 5. Word 4 is producer-packed but not directly read by Resolve. Exact runtime type, dimensions, pitch, sample count, slice, level, region, generation, lifetime, completion, and native implementation remain unresolved.
